thread:
Raj (CSM): Heads-up: VerdantHealth just fell off usage cliff after their security team changed SAML attributes. 30-day active integrations went from 210 -> 58. Renewal in ~3w. tagging for triage.

analytics-bot: Auto-summary: VerdantHealth: integrations_active: 210 -> 58 (-72%), auth.errors: saml.attribute_missing (2,340), recent window 02:10-02:30 UTC. health dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/verdanthealth/health

Zoe (Solutions Eng): Likely missing required NameID or group mapping. We should share a short troubleshooting checklist for their IdP. If quick patch won't help, recommend a transient bypass for service accounts.

Priya (Customer Ops): New procurement lead (K. Morales) started last week; previous POC left. Procurement already hearing from BeaconAI who offered a migration discount. Marco, any notes from your last exec call?

Marco (AE): BeaconAI ran a feature-matched pilot with Verdant last month. Customer liked Beacon's lower per-call cost but flagged several missing integrations. Our stickiness is integrations and SSO. We need immediate remediation and a short-term confidence play.

Raj (CSM): Proposed plays: 1) Admin outreach + admin screen-share to fix SAML mapping; 2) Offer 10-day Dedicated sandbox (no SLA/contractual language until Legal signs off); 3) Provide a short perf/feature comparison vs BeaconAI to procurement. Any objections?

Nina (Legal): We must not promise Dedicated or capacity guarantees in customer comms. We can approve a non-binding sandbox offer; Legal will draft neutral language. Loop me in before sending the offer.

Zoe (Solutions Eng): Quick workaround command for service accounts (internal):
```bash
# temporarily accept alternate NameID format for service accounts
redwoodctl auth saml override --org verdanthealth --accept-alt-nameid --duration 72h
```
Will prepare an admin-facing checklist with screenshots by EOD.

Priya (Customer Ops): I'll arrange the admin screen-share with K. Morales and their IdP team for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Raj, want me on the call?

Raj (CSM): Yes please join. Also please include a short FAQ comparing our integration matrix vs BeaconAI so procurement has concrete points. Marco, can you draft the comparison bullets? Keep it non-technical and procurement-friendly.

Marco (AE): On it. Will emphasize integrations supported, uptime history, data residency, and migration cost estimate. No pricing in thread until Finance signs off.

billing-bot: FYI: If we enable a Dedicated sandbox, finance needs to flag billing code and reconciliation notes. Temporary quotas billed at metered rate unless converted to contract.

analytics-bot: I'll monitor integrations_active and auth.errors. Alert if integrations_active doesn't recover to >65% baseline within 24h. :eyes:
